scope: Strategy-only visibility context for the bounded quest-XP package. It chooses modeled skill gates worth exposing as timing landmarks. It does not change factual eligibility, rank quests, choose a route, prescribe training, or allocate any player-chosen XP.

thresholds.timing_note: Expose this as a low threshold before training beyond it, because a fixed-XP quest in the bounded package can contribute afterwards.
Expose the Grand Tree gate next; its fixed Agility reward may cross later modeled gates but does not make the quest automatically timely.
Expose this downstream utility gate when Nature Spirit fixed Crafting XP is being considered.
Expose the Dig Site entry threshold before treating its fixed Herblore XP as a later skip.
Expose this later quest gate after fixed Herblore rewards, without selecting Eadgar's Ruse or its preparation path.
Expose Temple of the Eye's entry gate before treating its fixed Runecraft reward as a threshold skip.
Expose the Giants' Foundry quest entry gate as a modeled timing landmark.
Expose this Dig Site entry threshold before treating its fixed rewards as later progression.
Expose this downstream Fairy-ring path gate when evaluating bounded quest XP, without recommending a Woodcutting method.

decision_boundary.fixed_quest_xp: The analyzer may show current XP, resulting XP, level change, crossed visibility thresholds, direct quest prerequisites, transitive modeled quest closure, hard skill gates, item inputs, consumed inputs, reusable or equipment inputs, and outstanding preparation. A fixed reward does not remove any of those blockers.
decision_boundary.timing_statuses: do_now means all currently modeled hard and preparation conditions are satisfied, not that combat, travel, player readiness, or enjoyment has been inferred. gather_inputs, train_requirement, and finish_quest_chain may be emitted together when more than one blocker remains.
decision_boundary.player_chosen_xp: Every player-chosen XP award must be emitted with allocated_skill null and must never alter skill_xp, skills, thresholds, status, or a recommendation.
decision_boundary.no_route_claim: Output is a comparison input. It cannot say which quest should be completed next or that a level should be trained by a particular method.
